cautions.en: Pricing is driven by a low, fixed number of tracked keywords per tier (3 on the entry plan); a business tracking more than 3 brand terms must jump tiers.
No automatic overage charges are billed if the mention volume is exceeded, per the vendor's own statement, but the practical effect on data completeness in that case is not detailed.

capabilities.en: Real-time brand and keyword monitoring across social media (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube), news, blogs, forums and reviews.
Sentiment analysis and engagement tracking on collected mentions.
AI Brand Assistant and AI Events Detection on Pro tier and above.
Daily and weekly automated reports, with custom branded reports on higher tiers.

limitations.en: Entry-level Individual plan is capped at only 3 tracked keywords and 2,000 mentions/month, restrictive for multi-brand or multi-product tracking.
Real-time updates, AI features and advanced reports are gated behind the Pro tier and above ($499+/month), not available on entry plans.

Includes brand/social monitoring features as part of a broader marketing suite.
